headline: Every block of chocolate checked, not a sample.
label: #F3E9DA
heroLede: At the volumes Ringwood runs, a wrapping fault, a wrong label or a bad code on one block in thousands is easy to miss. Here's what a camera check could look like on your chocolate wrapping line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every block is wrapped and sealed, with no open ends or torn wrappers. An open wrapper lets chocolate bloom and comes back as a complaint.
labelLede: A milk chocolate block and a fruit and nut block look much the same in the wrapper, and one of them carries tree nuts. The camera checks every block carries the right wrapper for the chocolate inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every block. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Foil offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.alert: Four open ends in fifteen minutes. Check the wrapper.
